Dear Dr. Kumar,

Re: Mr. Henry Mathews, aged 24 years

I am writing to update you regarding Mr. Henry Mathews, a local club owner complicated STD. Proper           Commented [ESLDOC1]: who has been
follow-up would be highly appreciated.                                                                       diagnosed with secondary syphilis


As you know, Mr. Mathews presented with fever, a sore throat, a headache, malaise, and arthralgia along      Commented [ESLDOC2]: Today
with rashes on the genitals, extremities and trunk. On examination, there was a painless symmetrical
maculopapular rash all over his body, including the palms and soles with inflamed knuckles. In addition,     Commented [ESLDOC3]: the
the lesions on the genitals were flat, painless and velvety.                                                 (The article “the” is preferred when referring to body
                                                                                                             parts.)

The requested investigations revealed anemia with 10.5g/dl of hemoglobin, leukocytosis with 86%
neutrophils and low platelets. He was negative for HIV and hepatitis B and C. He was diagnosed with
secondary syphilis based on the positive results of RPR and TPPA. In addition, the bacteria Treponema
Pallidum bacteria was visible on the dark field microscopy.                                                  Commented [ESLDOC4]: p
                                                                                                             Commented [ESLDOC5]: were
Mr. Mathews was given a doxycycline tab of 100mg twice a day for 14 days, and a paracetamol tab of
1000mg four times a day for fever and arthralgia. He was advised to abstain from any sexual activity until
the rash heals completely and to report any new symptoms immediately. Local health department was            Commented [ESLDOC6]: The local
reported to.

Given the above, I kindly request your follow-up regarding Mr. Mathews’s condition. He requires
vaccination against hepatitis B and C and counseling on safe sexual practices. Please note, he needs to be
guided on treatment compliance and complications, he also needs to inform all possible contacts.

If you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

Doctor
